newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel 7-mth tax revenues up 1.3 percent.
newsitem.headline: Israel 7-mth tax revenues up 1.3 percent.

text.p: Israel's tax revenues since the beginning of the year totalled 62.8 billion shekels ($17.8 billion), an increase in real terms of 1.3 percent from 55 billion a year earlier, the Treasury said on Monday.
Income and property taxes totalled 34.7 billion, a real increase of 3.5 percent. Revenues from income tax registered a 10 percent rise.
Property tax revenues fell 27 percent because of a slowdown in real estate activity.

Customs and value added tax revenues totalled 26.7 billion shekels, up 1.1 percent in real terms. Customs revenues were down 6.0 percent while domestic taxes, excluding value added tax and including tax rises on fuel and cigarettes, increased 11 percent.
Other levies increased by some 10 percent, the Treasury said. ($ = 3.536 Israeli Shekels)
